seen: High-angle view over a sunlit meadow: red-haired rogue (upper left) holds a long blade extended toward the knight; knight (right, wide crouching lunge, black scarf streaming right) holds a greatsword low with the tip toward the lower-left foreground. No monsters: a duel.
action: {rogue} steps forward and drives her long blade at {knight}. Crouched in a wide lunge, he whips his greatsword up in a fast rising arc and knocks her blade aside with a loud clang and a burst of sparks. She is thrown back a step, her ponytail whipping, while his black scarf snaps in the wind and grass blades and petals blow across the field.
camera: The camera looks down from above and pushes in slowly.
plot_ru: Кадр 1 (общий план сверху). По факту картинки это дуэль: разбойница выпадом бьёт клинком, рыцарь снизу вверх отбивает двуручником, искры, она отскакивает на шаг. Камера медленно приближается сверху. Монстров в кадре нет.
